interface.longDescription: Sessionboard lets event organizers work with their speaker and session data in ChatGPT. Users can ask natural-language questions about sessions, speakers, contacts, and evaluations (answered through Sessionboard's SbQL query engine), search and cite specific events and sessions, build reports and analytics dashboards, and manage the event workspace — creating and updating sessions, contacts, exhibitors, sponsors, agenda drafts, and scheduling rules — all scoped to their own organization with OAuth sign-in.
capabilities: Ask natural-language questions about sessions, speakers, and evaluations
Search and cite events and sessions
Create and update sessions, contacts, exhibitors, and sponsors
Build agenda drafts, scheduling rules, dashboards, and reports
defaultPrompt: What events do we have in Sessionboard?
How many sessions are still pending review for the Global TechStack Conference?
